notes.scope: 化学学院 (chem.scu.edu.cn) and 化学工程学院 (ce.scu.edu.cn) are the two primary in-scope chemistry units. 高分子科学与工程学院 (cpse.scu.edu.cn, 专任教师 only) and 材料科学与工程学院 (mse.scu.edu.cn) were included since they host chemistry-related faculty.

coverage.化学学院: 127 records: 101 教授&研究员 + 25 副教授&副研究员 + 1 讲师. Titles derived from roster category pages.
coverage.化学工程学院: 152 records listed across 高层次人才/教学科研岗: 74 教授/研究员 + 79 副教授/副研究员/高级工程师 ... note the 讲师(26) and 专职博士后(21) categories on ce are enumerated below in this note; the professors array includes 74 senior + 79 associate + 26 lecturer = 179 non-postdoc science faculty.
coverage.高分子科学与工程学院: 专任教师 across 3 departments (高分子材料系, 高分子材料加工工程系, 医用高分子材料系); research areas not listed on roster.
coverage.材料科学与工程学院: 杰出人才 + 教授 + 副教授. 讲师 only via 讲师名录 (陈宝军) and admin/staff not enumerated.

notes.field_sources: For 化学学院 and 化学工程学院 roster pages, name/title/profile_url come from the official directory pages; name_en and research_area were filled only when visible on a fetched profile page. Most name_en and research_area left blank (not invented). 高分子 roster pages list email inline (not stored here).
